result.excerpts:
[S1] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Kya AI model ko customer review (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]
Kya AI model ko customer review Nahi. AI insaan asli grahak nahi hai — ise review/testimonial bata ke bata sakte hain? mat chalao. Product dikhane ke liye use karo. (L07)
Reviewed English translation: Do not present an AI actor as a real reviewing customer. Use an honest product demonstration or UGC-style showcase without claiming genuine customer experience.

[S2] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — UGC video (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]
• Flow → Video → Ingredients: chehra + character sheet + product sheet. • Course settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. • Prompt: camera hi phone hai, frame mein koi phone nahi; ghar ka kamra, studio nahi. • Dialogue chhota (Hindi, Devanagari mein likho), L05 ke hook se.
Reviewed English translation: In Flow choose Video → Ingredients and attach the face, character sheet and product sheet. Recorded settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. The camera itself is the phone: no phone should appear in the frame. Use a normal home room and short dialogue written in Hindi Devanagari, based on the L05 hook. Do not present an AI actor as a real reviewing customer.

[S3] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L04 Wedding Gift (course-material) [Lesson 04; lesson_4]
Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it. Place it on a soft silk cloth next to an open premium gift box with gold ribbon and a few rose petals, elegant wedding gifting mood, soft warm light, [PRODUCT] sharp in the foreground, realistic real-world scale, realistic festive product photography.
Reviewed English translation: For wedding gift photos, use the product sheet and keep the product unchanged. Place it on soft silk cloth beside an open premium gift box with gold ribbon and a few rose petals, using soft warm light. Keep the product sharp in the foreground at realistic real-world scale.

[S4] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Course overview and prerequisites (course-material) [Lesson 01; lesson_1]
Naam: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads (Skillomate). Format: Hinglish, chhote video lessons, ek AI presenter. Lessons: 8. Example product: white 60% compact mechanical keyboard, red accent keys, price ₹2,599 (sirf example). Kiske liye: jo apna product online bechte hain, aur jo dusron ke liye product ads banana chahte hain. Zarurat: phone, laptop, koi bhi product.
Reviewed English translation: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads has 8 lessons: 01 Course Intro; 02 Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (phone photos, Product Sheet, white studio/lifestyle/dark premium); 03 Model Ke Saath Product (character and product references, model shots and hands); 04 Festive Shoot + Colour Variants (Diwali, wedding scenes and a sheet for each colour); 05 ChatGPT Se Ad Plan (buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption and Flow prompts); 06 Photo Se Product Video (one movement with Ingredients); 07 UGC-Style Video (honest phone-style AI-presenter videos); 08 Finale (complete workflow, common mistakes, honesty and final project). You learn to create product photos, product videos and honest ads for your own products or clients. You need a phone, laptop and a product. Tools: Google Flow, ChatGPT and CapCut; a full CapCut editing tutorial is not taught. Course prompts are in lesson notes.

[S5] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Final ad kaise edit karein? (course-material) [Lesson 08; lesson_8]
Final ad kaise edit karein? Course mein CapCut tutorial nahi hai; final ad ka order: UGC hook → product videos → UGC → end card (price + order kaise karein). Text aur price editing mein daalo, AI se nahi.
Reviewed English translation: CapCut editing is not taught as a full tutorial in this course. The basic final-ad order is UGC hook → product videos → UGC → end card with the real price and how to order. Add text and price during editing, not with AI image generation.

[S6] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — chat G.P.T ne aisa feature likha jo (course-material) [Lesson 05; lesson_5]
chat G.P.T ne aisa feature likha jo Hata do. Prompt mein "use only the features I gave you" likho. (L05) product mein nahi
Reviewed English translation: Remove the unsupported feature. Tell the ad writer to use only the features you supplied and not invent anything new.

records.heading: Course overview and prerequisites
records.content: Naam: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads (Skillomate). Format: Hinglish, chhote video lessons, ek AI presenter. Lessons: 8. translations.english: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads has 8 lessons: 01 Course Intro; 02 Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (phone photos, Product Sheet, white studio/lifestyle/dark premium); 03 Model Ke Saath Product (character and product references, model shots and hands); 04 Festive Shoot + Colour Variants (Diwali, wedding scenes and a sheet for each colour); 05 ChatGPT Se Ad Plan (buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption and Flow prompts); 06 Photo Se Product Video (one movement with Ingredients); 07 UGC-Style Video (honest phone-style AI-presenter videos); 08 Finale (complete workflow, common mistakes, honesty and final project).
